thread:
aisha: Quick heads-up on Hawthorn week0 private onboarding. Two blockers: TGW route propagation missing for two AZ subnets, and their KMS alias rotation caused decrypt failures for our SIEM forwarder.

nate: tagging network/sre. which attachment id?

aisha: tgw-attach-0fa7e9c3. Their infra created per-AZ route tables and propagate=false in terraform.

sam-sre: running propagation check now. Looks like propagate=false on rt-0aa11bb22 and rt-0cc33dd44. Patching to true.

emma-ops: on KMS, forwarder logs show: "AccessDenied: not authorized to kms:Decrypt on alias/hawthorn-logs". They rotated keys yesterday and didn't grant rwd-forwarder-role.

aisha: FoxSec prefers grants over policy edits. Can we create a 24h grant for smoke?

sam-sre: yes, creating a 24h grant for arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rwd-forwarder-role, will run forwarder test afterwards.

ops-bot: scheduled job: create-temp-kms-grant for hawthorn at 2024-06-24T14:05:00Z.

sam-sre: propagation fix applied. traceroute from their app subnet -> 10.200.10.8 reaches infra hop. Creating grant g-0b1c2d3e now.

ops-bot: forwarder smoke test result: 2024-06-24T14:07:20Z Decrypt=SUCCESS, event forwarded to hawthorn-soc-smoke.

emma-ops: SIEM confirmed receipt. Marking audit-forwarding=green (smoke). Pending: Hawthorn Sec to sign-off on permanent key policy or automated grants.

aisha: added renewal-risk note: usage 16% of commit last 30d; renewal flag=medium if onboarding remains incomplete >10 business days. Recommend weekly exec sync until full green.

renewals-bot: noted renewal severity=medium; follow-up in 48h if no perm-policy.

aisha: summary: TGW propagate fix  done, temp KMS grant  done (smoke green), permanent key policy pending, renewal monitor set. I'll update the onboarding tracker and runbook with the KMS grant steps. Thanks all. :sparkles:
